title: Biocon subsidiary receives US FDA approval for Yesintek autoinjector
summary: Biocon's US subsidiary has received supplemental approval from the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for Yesintek single-dose prefilled autoinjectors. The approval is for two strengths of the autoinjector, which is used to treat conditions such as plaque psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, and Crohn's disease. Following the announcement, Biocon shares saw a 2% increase.
summary_points: Biocon's US subsidiary received supplemental US FDA approval for Yesintek prefilled autoinjectors.
The approval is for two strengths of the single-dose autoinjector.
Yesintek is used to treat conditions including plaque psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, and Crohn's disease.
